overall_notes: This paper presents a theoretical and empirical study of in-context generation (ICG) abilities in language models. The research uses synthetic datasets generated from a controlled hierarchical latent variable model and evaluates Transformer models of various sizes. The evaluation is exclusively automatic using the ICTR (In-Context Topic-Repetition Rate) metric. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed consolidation of duplicate entries and normalization to standard forms.
